## Fixed

- **No app icon** — `NotchWatch.app` (and the `.dmg`) shipped with the default generic icon in v0.3.0. The build now rasterizes the brand SVG to every size `iconutil` needs and packs a real `.icns` into the bundle before signing.
- **`brew install` 404** — the repository was private, so unauthenticated release-asset downloads (what `brew`'s cask installer does) always 404'd. The repo is now public.

## Notes

- Homebrew 6.0+ requires a one-time `brew trust --cask lixeas/notchwatch/notch-watch` before the first install of a non-official tap — documented in the README, not new in this release.
